name: Alex
description: Trains in the town square and dreams of going pro. Responds well to hearty meals and anything that feels like a win.

seo.title: Alex — Gridball Athlete
seo.description: Trains in the town square and dreams of going pro. Responds well to hearty meals and anything that feels like a win.

stardew.intro: Lives with grandparents George and Evelyn. Competitive, a little vain, and secretly worried he will not make it as an athlete.

love: Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thirsty

heartEvents.title: Gridball toss
heartEvents.summary: Catch the gridball in the town square when he asks for a throw.

heartEvents.title: Book on the pier
heartEvents.summary: Find him reading alone at the pier — he opens up about his mom and his fears.

heartEvents.title: Recipe mail
heartEvents.summary: He sends you the Salmon Dinner recipe in the mail.

heartEvents.title: Cliffside talk
heartEvents.summary: Visit him on the cliff east of town; he admits he is unsure about his future.

heartEvents.title: Gridball letter
heartEvents.summary: A letter invites you to his house — he asks if you think he has what it takes.

heartEvents.title: Midnight gridball
heartEvents.summary: Meet him at the gridball cage after dark for a private game and a kiss.

relationships.name: George & Evelyn
relationships.note: Raised by his grandparents; their health weighs on him more than he lets on.

relationships.name: Dustin & Haley
relationships.note: Childhood friends — you will see them around town together.

trivia: Birthday on Summer 13 — Complete Breakfast is an easy loved gift if you have chickens and a kitchen.
